# tests&funnels

> tests&funnels (t&f) is a Delhi AI agency that automates marketing, sales and operations with AI agents, a production house for realistic media, UGC, influencer marketing and personal branding, and a partner in Incube8, an incubator offering training, validation, acceleration, office space and funding.

Each link below goes to a Markdown copy of the page. The canonical HTML page is the same address without index.md. Figures on case-study pages state their source on the page. Prices and dates are current as of 14 November 2026.


## Key facts

- Name: tests&funnels, also written t&f
- Based in: Delhi, India
- Contact: +91 75079 94138 (phone and WhatsApp), admin@testsandfunnels.com
- Founders: Shrey Talreja and Soyam Aggarwal. Business Head: Pinky Dhingra
- Niches: e-commerce brands, hospitals and clinics, personal brands
- Agency clients deal with one point of contact

## Services

- [AI automation](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/index.md): AI automation agency in Delhi: agents that run the manual work of marketing, sales and operations, with one point of contact and people in review.
- [Production house](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/index.md): Production house in Delhi for realistic media, UGC, influencer marketing and personal branding, planned for reuse across your ads and channels.
- [Personal branding and influencer creation](https://testsandfunnels.com/personal-branding/index.md): Personal branding agency in Delhi: positioning, repeatable video content, influencer creation and growth on Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn.
- [Services](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/index.md): Digital marketing services in Delhi: performance marketing, brand building, social media, cold outreach, SEO, websites and sales, run by agents and a team.
- [Industries](https://testsandfunnels.com/industries/index.md): A niche marketing agency for e-commerce brands, hospitals and clinics, and personal brands, with ROI-positive growth as the goal.
- [Social media agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/social-media-agents/index.md): AI social media agents for scripting, content calendars, video editing, publishing, insights, influencer outreach and comment replies, within your limits.
- [Advertising agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/advertising-agents/index.md): AI advertising agents that set up and optimize Google, Meta and LinkedIn campaigns and report on ad performance, within the budgets you approve.
- [Sales agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/sales-agents/index.md): AI sales agents that capture leads, follow up on email and WhatsApp and run tele-call workflows, so every lead is tracked from first touch.
- [Operations agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/operations-agents/index.md): Operations automation with AI agents: MIS, lead and order dashboards, reports and plans kept current, so your team stops rebuilding them by hand.
- [Product and lifestyle shoots](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/product-and-lifestyle-shoots/index.md): E-commerce product photography and lifestyle video planned for your ad formats, shot in bulk and cut down for every channel you run ads on.
- [AI visuals and video](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/ai-visuals-and-video/index.md): AI video ads and visuals for concepts, variations and scenes that are costly to shoot, built on Higgsfield and reviewed by a person before they run.
- [UGC](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/ugc/index.md): UGC agency for brands in India: creator-style video and photos with briefs, creator selection, review and cut-downs for your ads and social.
- [Performance marketing](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/performance-marketing/index.md): Performance marketing agency in Delhi: Google, Meta and LinkedIn campaigns planned from unit economics and tested at every stage of the funnel.
- [Brand building](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/brand-building/index.md): Brand building agency in Delhi: research, positioning, brand voice, messaging, design and storytelling that build recognition and trust.
- [Social media management](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/social-media-management/index.md): Social media management agency in Delhi: platform-specific content, reels, content calendars and community engagement, with agents on the repeat work.
- [Cold outreach](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/cold-outreach/index.md): Cold outreach services for B2B leads: data sourcing, email, WhatsApp and social DMs, and CRM automation aimed at qualified leads and demos.
- [Visibility optimization](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/visibility-optimization/index.md): AI search optimization: SEO, AEO and GEO audits and strategy to be found on Google, maps, voice search and in AI answers. No ranking promises.
- [Website development](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/website-development/index.md): Website development company in Delhi: websites, landing pages and Shopify stores built to convert, with conversion tracking set up from day one.
- [Sales services](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/sales-services/index.md): Lead conversion services in Delhi: telecalling and follow-ups, sales training and enablement, and CRM and sales ops setup.
- [E-commerce brands](https://testsandfunnels.com/industries/e-commerce/index.md): E-commerce marketing agency in India: Meta and Google Ads, Shopify stores, product photography and SEO, reported on ROAS and cost per acquisition.
- [Hospitals and clinics](https://testsandfunnels.com/industries/healthcare/index.md): Healthcare marketing agency for hospitals and clinics: local SEO, lead campaigns, websites and enquiry follow-up, within advertising rules.
